answer_1.quote: Despite the success of LVLMs, previous work has revealed that their main components, i.e., LLMs and VLPMs, both suffer from hallucination. Especially, LLMs tend to hallucinate unintended text, and VLPMs might generate nonexistent objects in the image (termed as object hallucination).

answer_2.quote: We first use the CHAIR (Caption Hallucination Assessment with Image Relevance) metric, and examine the hallucination degree of several representative LVLMs on the MSCOCO dataset.
